items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, requeues, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; reported site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls, $901.90 cost, 228 errors, and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs are incomplete; monthly budget ceilings are blank; and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The 30-day scorecard has 39 improvements awaiting measurement, 8 failed requests, and only 2 proven outcomes. Continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation work. Minimum measurement before reconsidering growth: attributable revenue by site, content, and tracking ID for the same period as a complete reconciled AI and non-AI cost ledger; approved budget ceilings; and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn.

Handoff: continue the existing revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation work only. Retain the $4.92 provider aggregate as unattributed, do not treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, or pilot output counts as financial performance, and do not create duplicate telemetry requests.
